# Two commodities whose codes share an ending, both refused, and an account
# kept in one of them.
#
# Neither `ZZ` nor `XZZ` is an ISO 4217 code, so both are refused in the
# CURRENCY namespace. The account is kept in `XZZ`, so its own failure names
# `(CURRENCY, XZZ)` — and `ZZ` is the tail of that.
#
# The cause carried into the tax table's refusal has to be the commodity the
# account actually names. `ZZ` explains nothing about it.
2026-01-01 commodity ZZ
	mnemonic: "ZZ"
	fullname: "Not A Currency"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity XZZ
	mnemonic: "XZZ"
	fullname: "Also Not A Currency"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank XZZ
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XZZ"

taxtable "GST"
	entry:
		account: "Assets:Bank XZZ"
		amount: 5.0
		type: percentage
